gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-quando: Neon-lit and wide-spaced, Outrun Future draws every outline with a line you could trace without a wobble. Quando follows with a serif body whose tall middle zone and sparse spacing give the pair its strongest quality: a bookish voice under a synthwave shout.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-sora: Chrome-bright and confident, Outrun Future stretches its tall lowercase across wide gaps in a uniform outline. Sora, though, keeps its curves crisp and geometric, and its more modest lowercase suits steady text where the heading prefers to make an entrance.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-space-grotesk: Outrun Future's outlines hold a single uniform width, spaced generously and topped with short ascenders over a large lowercase body. Space Grotesk then reads like open, geometric ribbon, comfortable to follow line after line.
gen-dafont-over-there-cabin: Over There has the stiff swagger of an old field poster. Cabin softens it with bent-tubing sans-serif curves and open endings, and that friendly warmth against the commanding heading is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-over-there-dm-sans: Over There looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, with generous white space between its vintage-military letters, and it holds its ground up top. DM Sans below is friendly and approachable, easy company over a whole page.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-alpino: Alpino has a cozy, casual manner, with tall letters, tight spacing and curve endings kept well apart. And above it, Over There adds its fixed-nib, vintage-military command, so a long page reads warmly but never flat.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-familjen-grotes: Over There looks like it was drawn with a fixed-width nib, wirelike and commanding, with plenty of room between glyphs. Familjen Grotesk answers in a lively plain sans, its tall lowercase and half-open bowls giving the pair real push and pull.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-hind: Military stencil attitude, vintage and firm. Over There does best at commanding attention with spaced, fixed-nib letters, while Hind quietly handles the everyday work, its lowercase close to the capitals and its strokes steady.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-nunito: Nunito brings big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem, friendly and contemporary. Over There, with its vintage-military nib lines and wide gaps, sits above it, and a long passage in Nunito feels gentle by comparison.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Brusque and vintage, a fixed-nib military hand with space to spare. Pilcrow Rounded is the opposite in temperament: warm plain sans letters with tall lowercase, big counters and tightly packed spacing, where Over There is built to command.
